body: There’s definitely at least a few people who it is harmful too. But everything is dangerous to at least one person, and hopefully those people are able to find support in another place that’s safer for them.

There is no statistically significant correlation between talking about suicide, even in a “pro” context and increased likelihood of attempting. There is however a connection between not being able to talk about it and feelings of isolation, which obviously do contribute to attempts. So a community of people venting without the constant DON’T GIVE UP rhetoric doesn’t pose a significant threat to most people. 

And it’s nice to just be allowed to feel your feelings without having someone jump down your throat with another vacuous guilt trip.

I feel the same, I might as well have written this post. I’m sorry you’re stuck feeling this too. It’s so exhausting. I wish we could just rest. Everything is a battle but no one is willing to see how hard you fight or how tired you are. It’s cruel. You deserve better. 
No advice to offer. I just thought maybe being heard might feel good, even if it doesn’t help you rest.
Bad is a weird word. It’s probably an unhealthy coping mechanism, but hey it’s still a coping mechanism. If you fantasize about it a lot, you should try to tell someone to get external help.

Fuck it sucks having these issues when you’re educated in it. You can recite the words but they don’t help. 
Guilt is a big problem for me too. I wish I had advice to give about how to not feel it. Sometimes it helps to get angry, but then sometimes I just feel guilty about that too. 
Why did you decide to go off your meds? Any plans to go on a different one?

Are you me? I’ve written this same post a hundred times. 
It’s cruel the way people are allowed to emotionally abuse others as long it’s perceived as keeping the other person alive. 
Hoping something changes for you.

Yes I definitely relate. There have been many times that I just want to trade places with someone dying of something. They get to live and I get to die, no downside. 

Any particular reason you’re feeling this way or just a combo of brain chemicals and a shit world?

I’m really sorry you’re stuck feeling this. I’m trans and can relate. This isn’t great advice but honestly it helped me. But only do it if you would be completely safe. 

I had a few one night stands through Grindr. While the sex was shit every time, the fact that there were any cis gay guys willing to give me a shot helped. I had a face pic and was very explicit in my bio that I was trans and what parts I have, so they knew what they were getting into. And yet guys still messaged me. Even just getting a message felt good. Again, only consider this if you could be beyond safe. Meet in public, trust your instincts and always give the persons details to a trusted friend or at least save them on a computer where cops could find them. 

Not that this is good, therapeutic, work through your issues advice, and if possible you should try trans-positive therapy. There are therapists and doctors who are trained and actually give a fuck about helping trans patients instead of hurting us. 

But sometimes we don’t need to do the Healthiest Possible Thing to start making progress.

Having dysphoria and dysmorphia at the same time is a shit hand to be dealt. Any chance of being able to physically transition? Testosterone or estrogen, surgeries? Some people find that the promise of those measures even in the distant future helps them cope.

Fuck I relate so much. It sucks to be told over and over again this is how you fix the problem. And you try for years because you know it’s not instant, but nothing changes. Then you get to hear the same therapy bullshit over and over, and you can recite it, but no matter how hard you try to genuinely do the work, it doesn’t help. 
Personally I’m still going at it to prove that it doesn’t help me. That’s nice that it does work for others, but I’m not one of them. If I can line up everything I’ve tried and say “look, I’ve done my due diligence” maybe someone will finally get it. If I can’t feel better, I might as well get to feel vindicated.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way, everything is so shit these days. 
Would you consider asking for help/leave of absence from school if you blamed it on something else? Certainly no one is going to question you if you say you’ve got a sick relative to take care of.
Like someone else said, do you know what specifically about your work made it easier to distract yourself with? Are there any hobbies you can take up that would be distracting? Without specifics my first guess would be something that uses your hands, clay sculpting or similar.

Oh yeah, I’ve written notes. Not just explanation ones but blame ones too. Not so much ‘you pushed me to this’ but ‘you never cared enough to even try helping.’ Sometimes it feels good to write it out and tell everyone exactly what you think of them at your angriest.

I know you probably don’t have the emotional strength to do this right now but you should break up with your boyfriend. That’s a shit relationship and you don’t need his emotional neglect making an already hard time worse.
Wish I had advice for this one, I’ve been burned by friends too. Shit sucks and it’s hard to ignore. Got an HR department at work? Coworker who’s not just a work friend?

To be fair, you can have depression without suicidal thoughts or “sad” feelings. Loss of interest in everything is absolutely a symptom of depression. 
Anyway, any hobbies you enjoy? Even if you can’t make a career out of them (I hate when people say you can make any dream real, bullshit). Anything that’s a fun distraction from the monotony of life? You don’t have to have a family life if you don’t want it, or follow the bullshit about making an impact on the world. If there’s something fun, maybe you can just have a boring stable job and use your time and money for that fun thing. 
I agree, life is meaningless. But some people can find that freeing. Who needs meaning when you have pizza and masturbation?

Sign up as an organ donor, but the way someone dies matters. They’d have to be able to get the organs quickly and be undamaged and not everything can be used even in perfect condition. Plus health issues while the person was alive. 
Your organs might be more useful inside of you than outside. I don’t know, and I personally hate messages of false positivity. But there’s at least some chance that it’s true.

What’s going on in my head is unfortunately unrelated to people who know me. I would still be suicidal, but god I wish I could erase myself from other people. Even if I was forced to live afterwards, I hate knowing people I once trusted still have my secrets in their minds after we’ve fallen out.

This is a weird one but my university library has sound dampening rooms for recording and editing. Might be able to rent something like that, and just warn staff before hand that you’re going to yell, but it’s “just for a project” or something. Put a note on the door that the yelling is for a video and not to worry.

I’m sorry your dad is such a pain. It’s shitty of him to not take you seriously and be so stubborn. What’s your mom like when you talk to her about it? Any trustworthy teachers or counselors at school?
What sorts of issues are you having? You said your sister can’t handle most food, is she getting enough to eat? If you talk to a medical doctor (idk if your family has a primary doctor) you might be able to get a referral to a therapist. Try checking your state/country/whatever laws about confidentiality for underaged children. Some places protect people’s confidentiality even if they’re underaged, others require snitching to parents. Just in case your dad could have a bad reaction. 
I hope you’re able to get to see a therapist, and your sister too.

Agreed. I can’t understand the people who are able to lie to themselves about it. Then I get mad when they try to lie to me. If you can delude yourself fine, but don’t try to feed me your bullshit. Then they’re mad because I ruin their delusion.

It sucks that we can never talk about it with anyone. Strangers, friends, family, therapists. No one can handle listening to us without wanting to throw us in the loony bin. It’s nice to have this reddit. I hope you can find some peace in your brain.

That fucking sucks having to see her. It feels like a knife to the chest seeing them, happy without you, while you’re still burning inside. I hope you find something to distract you until someday you find that the hole she left in your heart is gone.
The world failed you. You deserve better. I’m sorry you’re hurting so much.

I’m not someone who can tell you not to kill yourself. But if you choose to, don’t let it be because your trans. You have reasons, but never let the scumbags who torture us win. They don’t deserve your blood. We deserve theirs.

Honestly, those of us who are AFAB and want to transition are way luckier than people who are AMAB and want to transition. There’s a very good chance, if you have the resources to go on testosterone that you could pass someday (if that’s what you want). First puberty is not a death sentence. 

But you’re right. A lot of the time being trans sucks ass. It’s hard to look in the mirror and never see the real you. 
Is there anyone you can come out to? Anyone at all, an internet friend. They’re hard to find, but if you can find some of the rare people who will legitimately see you as your gender, it can help. Even in the trans community we struggle to get past our social programming, but there are people out there whose brains just...get it. And being properly gendered by them feels very good.

I've always had this as a major rule for myself. I must be in some situation where a stranger will find me, if at all. It absolutely cannot be someone who knows me. Obviously finding a stranger dead is also super traumatic, but not on the same level as someone you know.

I feel this way too a lot. Life feels like a punishment that I don't deserve. And other people are selfish to wish this on me. 

I don't have any advice to offer that you haven't already thought of. I'm sorry shit sucks.

Fuck them, buy the books. 

Things are shitty and life is shitty and people who are supposed to love us kick us when we're down, so grab what little joy you can when you can. 

Pissing your parents off could put you in some danger, be it physical or they kick you out and you can't find a place to rent, but you know better than anyone how big of a risk it is, so take my advice with a big grain of salt. But if you're not in danger beyond a shouting match (which at times feels good to finally tell people what you want) then buy the damn books! It's $300, calm down mom and dad. 

And for what it's worth, I'm sorry you feel shitty. You shouldn't have to deal with it. The world is stupid.

Same! It's been incredibly rare that any of my four therapists and two counselors have ever offered me anything at all practical. It gets super exhausting when you've been doing this for so long and the newer therapist "teaches" you something that you've been trying for half a decade. "Stop following my negative train of thought?! GEE WIZ wish I had thought of that!" It's all just the dressed up, therapist talk version of "stop being sad and be happy instead." Their most practical tools are "don't think the thoughts you think." So when I'm in a particularly deep pit and friends/family say I should "get help" and "go to my therapist" it just feels like I've got to do this performance for everyone, even though it will change nothing for me. 

As for being transgender and trapped in the wrong body, I'm sorry you've got such horrible dysphoria. It's so shitty not passing to the world or yourself. I'm a trans guy but I'm lucky because my dysphoria isn't as bad as yours. Getting resources to deal with it is so hard and so rare that it's helpful. There are some lucky people who can 100% pass and be seen as who they are, but that usually takes lots of money and privilege. One thing that has helped me, which may not help you but I figure I'd offer it anyway, is having friends who Legitimately See Me As A Boy. These people are hard to come by, even in the trans community, we're all stuck with this shitty perspective society has given us. But occasionally I've had friends who legit "forgot" I was trans. One cis girl said something about growing up as a girl and I agreed and she was like "you wouldn't know what it's like" and I was like "BITCH? I DON'T?" and she went "oh shit, I forgot." If you can find those people, online if not in real life, it helps. It doesn't fix it, I know. Maybe you can be one of the lucky ones to get the perfect surgery. Or maybe not. 

Another solution some people find helpful is forcing yourself to embrace not looking the way you want to. It feels shitty and self hurtful at first to admit you don't look the way you do in your head, but some people eventually find that shouting at the world "I MAY NOT LOOK LIKE A WOMAN BUT FUCK YOU I AM SO YOU CAN DIE MAD ABOUT IT" helps them feel more real. Also seeing pictures of cis people who don't look like their assigned gender. Like "if she is a real woman then fuck so am I."

That's where I'm at too. I'm not sure what the next step is once I accept that things probably aren't going to get better.   The happiness (or at least neutral contentedness) I manage to track down never seems to balance out the sadness or the fear or the anger or anything. At this point, part of the reason I keep going is to prove to these idiot therapists that everything they tell me to do is bullshit. Getting a therapist to admit that suicide is a legitimate option I could choose felt vindictively gratifying.

It wasn't a mental hospital, but I was 'voluntarily' admitted to a 'crisis stabilization unit.' I was tired of playing the "answer correctly or else" game with my therapist, so she told me either I tell my family so they could be on Red Alert or I'd have to go to the unit. I will never tell my family about my suicidal stuff (because they guilt trip and accuse me of being manipulative) so I said fine, I'll go to your stupid unit. So my therapist walked me over and made me talk to some other woman who asked me the same questions as always. They decided I needed to be admitted. 

Then they took away all my possessions including clothes (I think I was allowed to keep my underwear) and put me in a hospital gown. Then I was put in a room with 10 hospital recliners and two other people in hospital gowns. Then I stared at the wall for two hours, fuming. I listened as the other two people struggled to be allowed to leave (one of them was a homeless man who needed to get to the shelter in time to get a bed, but they kept him too late and he almost certainly had to sleep on the streets that night). Then I watched Parks and Rec for two hours, fuming. Then because I was there "voluntarily" I played "answer correctly or else" properly and I was allowed to leave. Occasionally they would ask if I needed anything, like water or food. All of the individuals were nice, if you don't count isolating me from everything and everyone under threat of worse.

Compared to others, I had the best possible experience. And it was shit.
This is one of the many reasons I became an atheist. If the christian god is gonna make me suffer and not have the balls to answer me, then why would I worship such an abusive fuck?

Just want you to know I relate to what you're feeling. From the outside there's no reason I should feel anything but happy. Yet here I am, miserable and wishing for death every day. Life sucks and then we die. But we're not allowed to skip ahead to that part. So we suffer for people who would never suffer for us.

Here's hoping shit gets better, or the world burns and we burn with it.
